title: dnd-5e-2024 spell stats (docs/rulesets.md#spells)
description: Stored inputs only; spells derive nothing in v1 except an embedded stat block's ability modifiers and saves (docs/rulesets.md#the-ruleset-module). Cross-field rules are checks in checks.ts (docs/rulesets.md#consistency-checks).

classes.description: The classes whose spell lists include the spell, printed in the level line and linked: "Level 1 Evocation (Sorcerer, Wizard)".

trigger.description: What a reaction or triggered bonus action responds to, rendered inline after "Reaction, which you take". Rules text, so a spell name can be italic.

note.description: Printed as written after the unit, for a casting time the fields can't express: "(Overgrowth) or 8 hours (Enrichment)".

ritual.description: The spell can be cast as a ritual.

range.description: Range. A distance range has feet or miles, not both.

text.description: The material exactly as printed, including any cost and "which the spell consumes" wording.

costGp.description: The cost in GP, for filters and checks only; a cost in other coins converts (2 CP is 0.02). Adds no words to the card.

consumed.description: The spell consumes the material. Data only; adds no words to the card.

duration.description: Duration, read "Instantaneous", "1 hour", "Concentration, up to 1 minute", and so on.

upTo.description: A timed duration without Concentration that the SRD prints as "Up to 8 hours".

higherLevels.description: "Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot". Leveled spells only.

statBlocks.description: Stat blocks printed only inside this spell, such as Summon Dragon's Draconic Spirit.
